actionTaken: Purged syringe barrel under 30 PSI and re-primed fluid delivery line.
resolutionSummary: Similar cavitation symptoms occurred 16 times on Line 3; in 14 cases, purging the air pockets from the syringe barrel resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Ultrasonic cleaning of 30-gauge needle tip and replaced dried fluid tip filter.
resolutionSummary: Similar bore restriction symptoms occurred 12 times on Line 1; in 11 cases, cleaning nozzle tip buildup and flushing the needle bore resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Verified incoming batch thixotropic index and adjusted syringe temperature controller to 23°C.
resolutionSummary: Similar viscosity slump symptoms occurred 10 times on Line 2; in 9 cases, adjusting temperature regulation for the new epoxy lot resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Replaced faulty pneumatic line pressure regulator and tightened quick-connect air couplings.
resolutionSummary: Similar pneumatic instability occurred 15 times on Line 4; in 13 cases, rebuilding the line pressure regulator resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Re-calibrated laser height sensor and set needle standoff clearance to 0.15mm.
resolutionSummary: Similar spreading symptoms occurred 9 times on Line 1; in 8 cases, re-calibrating the Z-axis needle standoff height resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Restored validated recipe valve open-time from 45ms to 32ms.
resolutionSummary: Similar oversized dot symptoms occurred 11 times on Line 2; in 10 cases, resetting the valve open-time parameter to the validated recipe resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Replaced exhausted solder paste syringe and purged prime line.
resolutionSummary: Similar starvation symptoms occurred 15 times on Line 3; in all 15 cases, replacing the near-empty cartridge resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Replaced worn diaphragm seal and needle seat inside the pneumatic dispensing valve.
resolutionSummary: Similar volume drift after pauses occurred 12 times on Line 4; in 10 cases, replacing the worn valve diaphragm seal resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Replaced paste filter cartridge and flushed delivery fluidics to clear solder powder aggregates.
resolutionSummary: Similar intermittent missing dot incidents occurred 8 times on Line 2; in 7 cases, clearing particle aggregates from the supply filter resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Reduced gantry XY acceleration and tuned Z-axis retract deceleration curve.
resolutionSummary: Similar dot tailing and elongation occurred 13 times on Line 1; in 12 cases, reducing motion speed and tuning gantry deceleration resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Enabled automatic idle purge routine (5s shot every 3 min) and cleaned needle tip.
resolutionSummary: Similar in-needle curing symptoms occurred 12 times on Line 3; in 11 cases, enabling automatic purge during pauses resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Stabilized cleanroom HVAC enclosure temperature within ±1.0°C specification.
resolutionSummary: Similar thermal spread incidents occurred 11 times on Line 4; in 10 cases, stabilizing enclosure ambient temperature resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Quarantined defective thermal paste lot and primed fresh certified cartridge.
resolutionSummary: Similar lot anomaly incidents occurred 7 times on Line 2; in 6 cases, replacing the contaminated material cartridge resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Automated centrifugal deaeration & mixing of solder paste prior to loading.
resolutionSummary: Similar filler settling incidents occurred 10 times on Line 3; in 9 cases, re-mixing and conditioning the separated material resolved the issue.

actionTaken: Replaced crusted needle tip and added solvent tip-wipe station cycle.
resolutionSummary: Similar tip crusting incidents occurred 9 times on Line 1; in 8 cases, cleaning tip buildup and wiping the nozzle orifice resolved the issue.
